item.title: iPhone 18 Pro: 256GB Base, 40% BOM Rise, Price Spike
item.description: Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro may retain a 256 GB base while a near‑40% BOM rise pushes the price $200‑$300 higher, reflecting wider component cost pressures.
